---
title: "Quick reference"
---

## Keyboard shortcuts (Windows)

| Task | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Command Palette (find any command) | **Ctrl + Shift + P** |
| Run current line or selection | **Ctrl + Enter** |
| Run the whole file | Click **▶** at the top right of the editor |
| Save | **Ctrl + S** |
| New window | **Ctrl + Shift + N** |
| Open folder | **Ctrl + K**, then **Ctrl + O** |
| Quick-open a file by name | **Ctrl + P** |
| Explorer / Search / Source Control / Extensions | **Ctrl + Shift + E** / **F** / **G** / **X** |
| Show/hide the side bar | **Ctrl + B** |
| Comment or uncomment lines | **Ctrl + /** |
| Find / Find in all files | **Ctrl + F** / **Ctrl + Shift + F** |
| Markdown preview | **Ctrl + Shift + V** |
| Quarto preview | **Ctrl + Shift + K** |
| Change color theme | **Ctrl + K**, then **Ctrl + T** |

On a Mac, use **Cmd** instead of **Ctrl**.

## Coming from RStudio?

| In RStudio you… | In Positron you… |
|---|---|
| Open an `.Rproj` file | **File → Open Folder…** |
| Use the Environment tab | Use the **Variables** pane |
| Run `View(df)` | Same, or click the table icon in Variables (opens the Data Explorer) |
| Use the Files tab | Use the **Explorer** |
| Use the Git tab | Use **Source Control** (**Ctrl + Shift + G**) |
| Set R version in Global Options | Use the **interpreter picker** (top right) |
| Use Tools → Global Options | Use **File → Preferences → Settings** (**Ctrl + ,**) |
| Click **Knit** / **Render** | Click **Preview** above a `.qmd` file (**Ctrl + Shift + K**). See the [Quarto training](../intro-to-quarto/index.qmd) |
| Insert a chunk (Ctrl + Alt + I) | Same shortcut, or Command Palette → **Quarto: Insert Code Cell** |

## Starting a new project checklist

- [ ] Create or open the folder (**File → Open Folder…** or **New Folder from Template…**)
- [ ] Create the folders: `scripts/`, `notebooks/`, `raw_data/`, `processed_data/`, `images/`, `reports/`, `downloads/`
- [ ] Add `README.md` ([template](../intro-to-github/readme-guide.qmd))
- [ ] Add `.here` (`here::set_here()`)
- [ ] Add `.gitignore` (data folders and secrets)
- [ ] Initialize Git and make a first commit
- [ ] Publish privately to **nv-ose** with GitHub Desktop
